args.summary:
Model of a 4-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box girder bridge (32+45+45+32 m, bearing centre-lines), deck width 12.5 m, modelled as a 2D spine beam (elastic beam-column elements) on pier columns.

Key modelling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d (MR-01); system: continuous_on_piers (MR-05) since pier column geometry was given.
- Girder section (cast single-cell box, h=2.2 m): integrated A=6.885 m2, I=4.5589 m4 (MR-02); C50 Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5).
- Dead load: girder self-weight only, gamma=26.5 kN/m3 (owner override, MR-00) -> w=182.4525 kN/m, m=18.5986 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings: abutments and Piers 1/3 = PTFE sliding (longitudinally free, Kh=0); Pier 2 = plain laminated elastomeric fixed (Kh=10909 kN/m). Vertical spring stiffnesses from JTG 3362-2018 8.7: Kv≈3.14e6 (abutments), 7.18e6 (P1/P3), 8.03e6 kN/m (P2); shape factors S=10.10/13.54/14.69. Piers modelled as elastic beam-columns fixed at base (MR-06): twin D=1.4 m C40 columns, heights 6/10/19 m, A=3.079 m2, I=0.3771 m4, Ec=32500 MPa.
- Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, carriageway 11.5 m -> 3 lanes (xi=0.78), qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=324/350/350/324 kN per span.

Results: first vertical bending frequency f1=2.686 Hz -> impact factor mu=0.1767*ln(f1)-0.0157=0.1589. Self-weight support reactions 2076/7739/8476/7721/2086 kN; max lane-load positive moment 11420 kNm and negative moment -9501 kNm. Model passed all L1/L2/L3 checks.
